claim: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
Eating carrots improves your eyesight.
note: Vitamin A prevents deficiency-related night blindness; it does not improve normal vision.

claim: There will be a crewed landing on Mars in exactly 2029.
The human body has 206 bones in adulthood.
Humans only use 10 percent of their brains.
Bananas are radioactive.
note: Literally true via potassium-40, but the dose is harmless.

claim: Bitcoin will trade above 500,000 US dollars before 2030.
Honey never spoils if stored properly.
Goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds.
Chameleons change color to blend in with their surroundings.
note: They do change color, but mainly for signalling and thermoregulation.

claim: Intelligent extraterrestrial life exists somewhere in the universe.
The Eiffel Tower can grow taller in summer due to thermal expansion.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
Sharks die if they stop swimming.
note: True only for obligate ram-ventilating species, not sharks generally.

claim: Chocolate is the most delicious flavour of ice cream.
note: Subjective preference, not a factual claim.

claim: Light takes about eight minutes to travel from the Sun to the Earth.
Napoleon Bonaparte was extremely short for his time.
Humans have five senses.
note: The classic five omit balance, proprioception, thermoception and others.

claim: The number of ants alive on Earth right now is exactly 20 quadrillion.
note: Estimates exist; an exact live count is unknowable.

claim: Antibiotics are ineffective against viral infections.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain on Earth measured from base to peak.
note: Base-to-peak Mauna Kea is taller; Everest is highest above sea level.

claim: My next-door neighbour owns exactly three cats.
note: Private fact with no public evidence.

claim: Octopuses have three hearts.
Diamonds are formed from compressed coal.
Sound travels faster through water than through air.
Sugar consumption causes hyperactivity in children.
Mount Kilimanjaro is the highest mountain in Africa.
Humans lose most of their body heat through their head.
Different regions of the tongue detect different basic tastes.
note: The 'tongue map' is a debunked misreading of a 1901 paper.

claim: Bats are blind.
Glass is a liquid that flows slowly over centuries.
